diagnosis: The Bun native HTTP fetch handler extracts reportId from the URL and queries the SQLite database directly by ID, returning the report file from disk without verifying that the report's workspace_id matches the authenticated user's workspace or that the user has permission to access the specified workspaceId. An attacker can download sensitive financial reports belonging to any workspace by guessing or enumerating report IDs.
